title: Concentration against time for each order
caption: From the same start, a zero-order reaction falls in a straight line, a first-order one decays exponentially with a constant half-life, and a second-order one starts as fast but slows more, with half-lives that double.
alt: [A] against time from 1.0: a straight line to zero (zero order), an exponential curve (first order) and a curve that flattens more (second order).
description: Zero order: [A] falls by the same amount each second.
Second order: the first half-life is 3 s, the next 6 s.

checks.name: first order: the next half-life is also 3 s
second order: 0.5 → 0.25 takes 6 s, twice the first half-life
